test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Six persons, A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting in a straight line facing north (but not necessarily in the same order). Only one person sits to the left of D. Only two persons sit between F and C. B sits third to the right of E. D sits immediate left of F. E sits at the left end. To whom of the following both A and F sit immediate next to?
solution:
Given: Six persons, A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting in a straight line facing north.

1) Only one person sits to the left of D.

2) Only two persons sit between F and C.

3) B sits third to the right of E.

4) D sits immediate left of F.

5) E sits at the left end. 

Thus, the final arrangement:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a98e31fd6d0caaad70adbc965906f19ec666e0a2443023935df7880dba18cb5a.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7927b7a336e1d776cf43d5d1fbf17e4a20ce5f968671d03aec848fb7a29b120f.png] 

So, Both A and F sit immediate next to **B**.

Hence, the correct answer is** "B".**
